pages.description: Explore the fictional Northline Roofing residential roof-repair service for Birmingham and Troy, Michigan, and details to mention on a call.
pages.heading: Give your roof concern a clear next step.
pages.intro: A new mark on a ceiling. A change you noticed from the yard. Start by describing the concern, where you see it, and when it began.
pages.detailsHeading: A few details make a useful starting point.
pages.detailsIntro: These prompts can help you organize your questions before a call. They are not an assessment of your roof or a promise of a particular repair.

details.title: What have you noticed?
details.text: Describe the visible change or concern in your own words. If you already have photographs, note what they show.

details.title: Where and when?
details.text: Mention the part of the home involved and when you first noticed the issue. Include whether anything has changed since then.

details.title: What would you like to discuss?
details.text: Let the conversation begin with your questions about residential roof repair or roof inspection.

pages.inspectionText: Roof inspection is the other service in this demonstration. Use the contact page to find the phone details and the service area in one place.
pages.scopeNote: Repair methods, materials, pricing and scheduling are not specified in this fictional example.

details.title: Visible roof condition

details.title: Observed concerns

details.title: Questions before repair

pages.inspectionHeading: Bring your questions to the conversation.
